what: Physics gates for HAUL's truck simulation (tests/physics.test.mjs), committed before the measured runs. Each gate has an analytic referee; the simulation must land on it. 'wrong twins' are setups that must fail.

static_load.what: at rest on flat ground the tyres carry the truck's weight

brake_hold.what: all six wheels braked on a uniform slope: holds below theta_c = atan(mu cos), slides above

traction_budget.what: 6x6 with lockers on a uniform grade: climbs when feasible.js gives margin >= +0.12, spins out (no progress) when <= -0.12

coast_down.what: rolling on the flat in neutral from 10 m/s: deceleration from rolling resistance and drag (g rr + 0.5 rho CdA v^2 / m)

lockers_split_mu.what: wrong twin: open diffs on a split dirt|mud grade spin out where lockers climb (Logging Cut's second pitch)

levels_ramp.what: each level's steepest pitch is steeper than the last; the naive setup clears level 1 and fails levels 3, 4 and 5; the best diesel (high range, fuel map 1) and the best EV clear all five (tools/bot.mjs driver)

determinism.what: the same inputs give the same state digest after 20 s
